decisive_items: bilateral thigh intramuscular edema with enhancement
response.rationale: Proximal weakness, dysphagia, and thigh muscle edema on MRI strongly support juvenile dermatomyositis despite normal CK/EMG; thyroiditis is an incidental autoimmune comorbidity, while MCTD lacks specific antibodies and sarcoidosis lacks typical systemic features.

rejected.why: Thyroid dysfunction is present but cannot explain proximal weakness, dysphagia, and muscle edema; myopathy is not supported by normal CK/EMG.
Bilateral sacroiliitis and elevated inflammatory markers are nonspecific; no pulmonary, ocular, or nodal features of sarcoidosis.
No anti-U1RNP or other MCTD-specific antibodies; symptoms are better explained by JDM with concurrent autoimmune thyroiditis.
